data.name: Specters of the Void Sea
data.detailed_description:
THE ULTIMATE VR MULTICREW NAVAL WARFARE

Specters of the Void Sea redefines cooperative multiplayer in VR. You aren't just a passenger on a static ship, you are a vital piece of a complex, physics-driven vessel. Gather your friends, form a crew, and plunge into intense PvPvE naval battles where flawless communication and teamwork are your only lifelines against rival players and ruthless armadas.

Experience the raw, unpredictable chaos of age of sail ship-to-ship combat. Every aspect of your vessel requires manual, physical interaction.

While your navigator calculates the voyage trajectory on the top deck, your teammates must scramble through the complex rigging to manually trim the sails and catch the wind. When devastating enemy fire tears through your hull, you must rush below deck to physically hammer wood planks over dynamic hull leaks before the water drags your entire crew into the abyss. In the Void Sea, a synchronized and coordinated crew is the deadliest weapon on the water.

🚨 PLAYTESTERS🚨: Joining the Discord is mandatory to participate in the current playtest. I am handling feedback and bug reports through there.

MASTER PHYSICS-BASED VR SAILING AND AGE OF SAIL COMBAT

Everything in Specters of the Void Sea is built around 100% physical VR interaction.

TACTICAL SAILING & VESSEL MANAGEMENT

Coordinate with your crew to physically steer the wheel through dynamic, procedural storms. Manually pull ropes to trim sails, operate the physical multipurpose anchor winch to execute sharp turns, and slice down sails with your sword to rip them during boarding actions.

DYNAMIC REPAIRS & AMMUNITION

The Void Sea is unforgiving. Under heavy fire, you must physically manage black powder munitions to load cannons. When your ship takes damage, scramble below deck to physically patch dynamic hull leaks with wood planks and a hammer before the vessel sinks beneath the waves.

HIGHLY REPLAYABLE PROCEDURAL VOYAGES

No two journeys into the Void Sea are ever the same. Navigate a completely procedurally generated world where every single voyage takes your crew through a unique world layout of unpredictable threats and discoveries. Set foot on uncharted procedural islands teeming with enemies, hidden secrets, and ports. Explore towering mountains, delve into mythical craters, and brave ancient megalithic structures that hold the secrets to the powers of the anomalous zone. Every time you raise your sails, a brand new adventure and a completely unique set of cards awaits your crew.

REALISTIC FLINTLOCK FIREARMS

Experience true-to-life black powder mechanics. Wield a variety of period-accurate firearms including flintlock pistols, long-range muskets, and devastating close-quarters blunderbusses. Under the intense pressure of active combat, you must physically pour the powder, drop the lead ball, and pack it tight with your ramrod. In the Void Sea, muscle memory and reloading proficiency are just as lethal as your aim.

CLIMBING, BOARDING & DYNAMIC MOVEMENT

Verticality is your greatest advantage. Utilize ship-based grappling hooks to slide down from the crow's nest and launch surprise attacks on unsuspecting enemies below. Swing across the gap between vessels using physical ship ropes to initiate brutal boarding actions. Almost every part of your ship's rigging and architecture is climbable, allowing for high-stakes vertical PvP combat and rapid traversal while operating sailing mechanics.

VOID DIVING & ENERGY HARVESTING

Utilize advanced stroke-based swimming mechanics to dive beneath the surface of the Void. Explore sunken ruins and utilize movement-based magic system energy harvesting to gain mana from the powerful ancient trees found in the anomalous zone, a vital resource for your crew's survival and progression.

VOID MAGIC GESTURE SPELLCASTING

Channel the chaotic energies of the Void Sea through intuitive physical gestures. As the Wizard class, cast devastating elemental fire, earth, water or wind magic to manipulate enemies, alter movement physics, and control the battlefield from the deck of your ship.


BRUTAL PvPvE SWORDFIGHTS & DISMEMBERMENT

Every weapon and strike is fully physical, driven by weight and momentum. Wield deadly cutlasses and heavy battleaxes, utilizing a skill-based parrying and lunge system to outmaneuver opponents in visceral hand-to-hand combat. Launch yourself on ropes toward enemy vessels and cleave through their ranks with complete dismemberment and dynamic ragdoll physics as your crew carves a bloody path to the Entity before rival players do.

THE WORLD IS DYING.

Beyond the horizon lies the last frontier. Gather your crew, raise your sails, and venture into the Void Sea—the impossible ocean between realities where forgotten civilizations, ancient entities, and unimaginable treasures await. Every voyage may be your last, but it may also be the one that saves the world.

The Void Sea is an endless ocean that exists between worlds—a place where reality itself begins to break apart. Fragments of long-lost civilizations drift through its waters, impossible islands appear where no maps can explain them, and colossal entities older than history hunt anything reckless enough to cross into their domain.

The sea is alive. And it knows you're coming.

THE MEGALITHIC PROPHECY

Following a catastrophic volcanic explosion in the far waters, scout vessels of the Flantivian Republic of the Sea Peoples discovered it: a highly functioning, sentient megalithic entity. Prophesied for hundreds of thousands of years, the emergence of this ancient geometric artifact is an event that will ultimately decide if humanity will be able to expands past the bounds of the third realm, or is forced down to it for eternity.

The megalith's emergence has fractured the world. Many seek its power for personal gain and dominion, while others wish to harness it to free their families from the oppressive grip of the Dawning Spirit Empire of the Hailing Sun, a ruthless regime that has systematically birthed a new age of unethical trade and controversial wars across the Void Seas for the past century. Some have become entranced with the knowledge and powerful energy of the entity that they thirst for it so much they would even betray their closest comrades at a chance for the glory.

Some fight to harness it. Some fight to destroy it. But everyone wants their hand at the megalith, and the unimaginable powers locked within its knowledge.

A TRUE MULTICREW BOND

Every soul aboard your ship has a purpose. Victory belongs to the crew that adapts the fastest.

  • Warrior: Wield BattleAxes, lead the boarding charge, and wreck havoc on enemies in close range and with hand to hand combat!

  • Wizard: Bend reality with gesture-based gravity and fire magic, Propel ships with generated wind in the sails, light enemies on fire, and move the earth with your power!

  • Navigator: Utilize your spyglass and compass to read celestial patterns in the stars to identify journey route and navigate towards the center of the void seas!

  • Munitions Expert: Use latest technology optics to calculate cannon trajectories for maximum accuracy and damage!

As one of the last remaining Void Explorers, your mission is simple: sail farther than anyone has before, recover the relics capable of holding the fabric of reality together, and survive long enough to return home.

About the Developer

I am Vlad Bondarenco, a University Aerospace Engineering Student, and part-time game developer. Specters of the Void Sea is my debut multiplayer release on steam and my passion project that I have been working on throughout the past 2 years. I hope you enjoy the game, and can experience this fever dream of a project with your friends and make some lasting memories through the crazy moments you will find during your voyages through this perilous fantasy world!
If you like the game please share and support!
Join the discord to contact me and track/help the development progress through bug reports and feature requests!

data.short_description: Gather your crew and sail the Void Sea in a fully physical, multicrew VR pirate adventure. Engage in brutal PvPvE with flintlock firearms, melee weapons, gesture magic, and naval combat. Sail procedural worlds, patch leaks, and do what you can to survive the entities and players hunting you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (Minimum 8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR required. Tracked motion controllers required.
  • Additional Notes: Standing or Room-Scale setup required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 Super / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR required. Tracked motion controllers required.
  • Additional Notes: Standing or Room-Scale setup required.
